_README: GROUND TRUTH for AI threat quality. One entry per threat the model emitted on the
go-forward fixture model. Set verdict for each; leave note blank unless useful.
TRUE_POSITIVE  - a real threat that genuinely applies to this architecture
FALSE_POSITIVE - not real, not applicable, or generic boilerplate
DUPLICATE      - real, but the same underlying issue as another entry here;
put the key of the entry it duplicates in `duplicateOf`
DUPLICATE is the abstraction-level signal: if ONE mitigation would close both,
they are one threat. See docs/ui-guide and the findings register.
Unlabelled entries (verdict null) are EXCLUDED from scoring, so partial
labelling still produces a valid — just less complete — precision number.
